resources.string: Open quick capture menu over any app
Modern quick capture dock for Screen, Voice, Note, Search, and Capture Anything.
Enables instant 1-tap screen capture without repeated confirmation dialogs.

Mind only captures a single screen image at the exact moment you tap a Mind capture shortcut (Quick Settings tile, Side Button double-press, widget, or floating button). Mind does not read windows, monitor typing, or collect screen data in the background.
